issue.title: just check fails at lint (symvision): 18 private helpers imported across the split src/sase/history/chat_fork/ submodules
issue.description:
`just check` fails at lint (symvision) on clean master df956212b with no working-tree
changes. Symvision reports 18 private functions imported across module boundaries by
non-test files inside the new `src/sase/history/chat_fork/` package:

```
_blockquote, _fork_source_failure, _fork_source_has_failure,
_fork_source_has_proc_content, _fork_source_kind, _fork_source_optional_string,
_fork_source_string, _format_text_fence, _json_string, _load_json_object,
_markdown_code_span, _require_proc_info      in chat_fork/common.py
_format_clan_fork_source                     in chat_fork/clan.py
_format_failed_agent_body,
_format_failed_agent_section                 in chat_fork/failure.py
_format_family_fork_source                   in chat_fork/family.py
_format_proc_body, _format_proc_source       in chat_fork/proc.py
```

`git log` shows the package was introduced by 9a7fd2e99, `refactor: split chat_fork.py
into a focused package` (agent `bbugyi200.athena.toobig-41.chat_fork.0`), which broke the
911-line `src/sase/history/chat_fork.py` into `common/failure/proc/family/clan/build`
submodules. The submodules import each other's private helpers, which is exactly the
pattern symvision's private-import rule rejects.

Found while landing epic sase-sq.7.1 (glossary migration to a core web). The glossary
epic's own symvision findings were already resolved; with the six `chat_fork/*.py` files
excluded, symvision reports "All public/private classes/functions are used properly!", so
this package is the sole remaining blocker on the gate:

```
SASE_SYMVISION_BEAD_STATUS_ONLY=1 BD_COMMAND=tools/sase_bead .venv/bin/symvision src/sase \
  --exclude-decorator gate_command_entrypoint --exclude-decorator builtin_chop \
  --epic-symbol "sase-n4(get_usage_limit_config)" \
  --exclude-file src/sase/history/chat_fork/common.py \
  --exclude-file src/sase/history/chat_fork/clan.py \
  --exclude-file src/sase/history/chat_fork/failure.py \
  --exclude-file src/sase/history/chat_fork/family.py \
  --exclude-file src/sase/history/chat_fork/proc.py \
  --exclude-file src/sase/history/chat_fork/build.py
```

Scope: promote the helpers that are genuinely cross-module API within the package to
public names, or stop importing them across submodule boundaries (fold single-consumer
helpers back into their only caller). Verify with `just _lint-symvision` and `just check`.

This is not a duplicate of sase-ta (`_combine_mutation_outcomes` in the split bead
project-mutation modules), sase-mk, or sase-f4: same rule, different symbols, different
files, and a different introducing commit. It is the same recurring failure mode that
follows every toobig split, so the fix should also consider whether the split workflow
should run `just _lint-symvision` before landing.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: This is a deterministic static lint failure, not a timing-dependent test. Reproduced on a clean working tree at master df956212b: just _lint-symvision reports the same 18 symbols on every run, and the imports exist in committed source until the code changes. Re-running the gate cannot make it pass.
